McDonald’s as a fast food joint has been in operation in India Hardcastle opened its first McDonald's restaurant in [[Bandra]], Mumbai in 1996, three days after McDonald's other Indian franchisee have opened the first McDonald's outlet in the country in Basant Lok, [[Vasant Vihar]], Delhi.{{cite web |title='As long as you are sure of what goes in your food, you're safe': Smita Jatia, MD, McDonald's India West and South - ET BrandEquity |url=https://brandequity.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/business-of-brands/as-long-as-you-are-sure-of-what-goes-in-your-food-youre-safe-smita-jatia-md-mcdonalds-india-west-and-south/87499309 |website=ETBrandEquity.com |access-date=4 November 2021 |language=en}} The joint venture was converted into a master franchisee in 2010.{{cite news |title=McDonald's and its challenges worldwide: a market-by-market look |url=https://www.ft.com/content/f8ac22fc-a7c1-11e4-8e78-00144feab7de |website=Financial Times |date=29 January 2015 |accessdate=19 April 2019 |last1=Munshi |first1=Neil }} Amit Jatia, the Chairperson of Westlife Foodworld, acquired the McDonald's Corporation's 50% stake in Hardcastle for an undisclosed amount in late 2012. Hardcastle was merged into the listed group company Westlife Development, making the former a wholly owned subsidiary of the latter.{{cite news |title=McDonald's franchisee Hardcastle Restaurants merges with BSE-listed group company - Times of India |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/McDonalds-franchisee-Hardcastle-Restaurants-merges-with-BSE-listed-group-company/articleshow/17525421.cms |website=The Times of India |date=7 December 2012 |accessdate=19 April 2019}} Westlife Development was listed on the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] on 27 August 2013.{{cite web |title=WDL Listing |url=https://www.westlife.co.in/wdl-listing.php |website=Westlife Development |accessdate=19 April 2019}} McDonald's breakfast menu was launched in 2010, and made available all day long at select outlets from 2016. Westlife Foodworld Limited (formerly Westlife Development Limited) is an Indian fast food restaurant holding company. Its wholly owned subsidiary Hardcastle Restaurants Pvt. Ltd. (HRPL) holds the master franchise for McDonald's in western India and South India.
McDonald's Indian subsidiary, McDonald's India Private Ltd., acquired complete ownership of Connaught Plaza Restaurants Limited, its other Indian master franchisee, on 9 May 2019, ending a partnership established in 1995 and leaving Westlife Development as McDonald's only third-party master franchisee in India.
